name: SILENT CONTAINMENT
description: They brought in a man for questioning today. He wouldn’t speak — just kept his eyes fixed on the ICE fragment across the room. The soldiers pressed him, demanding to know where the unregistered piece came from. He said nothing. At 03:32, the shard came alive — blue light flooding the walls, a deep vibration rolling through the floor. I froze, heart pounding. Whatever this thing is, it’s not just a fragment. It’s something else. And we were standing too close.
